chunks: Muhammad ibn Humran narrated from his father, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever marries while the moon is in al-‘Aqrab will not see the good outcome.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, Imam Ja‘far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْحُسْنَى: the good outcome or favorable result
key_terms.الْعَقْرَبِ: al-‘Aqrab; the zodiacal sign or position of Scorpio

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about marrying when the moon is in al-‘Aqrab?
ai.summary: This hadith states that marriage contracted when the moon is in al-‘Aqrab is associated with not seeing a good outcome. It appears in the context of disliked times for marriage and reflects transmitted guidance on timing.
